question.text: Chapter 9 cites the global private credit market at approximately USD __ trillion in 2024, and the Indian private credit market at approximately USD __ billion. Fill the blanks.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the global private credit market was estimated at about USD 2 trillion in 2024 and the Indian private credit market was assessed at about USD 25 billion at that time. Option D matches both figures exactly. The Trap: Options A and B understate both market sizes relative to the source. Option C overstates both. Note that option D is the keyed correct answer here — it does not "understate" the figures. Note: The market-size figures and private-credit yield context appear on pages 210-211; the workbook does not prescribe a specific LP pitch-deck format around these figures.
